integrity_statement: The analytical proof treats all irrational slopes. The bundled finite-precision checker corroborates normalization and a selection of finite inequalities but is not an infinite proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to Lebesgue-uniform phase and the raw ordinal-pattern Shannon entropy of the standard irrational rotation using real representatives.
No claims for noise, nonconsecutive or global ordinal patterns, different observation functions, or arbitrary conjugacies.
The three-gap cylinder frequencies and the exponent formula for maximal gaps are known; the claim is the exact all-slope logarithmic Shannon cluster interval.
No independent mathematical validation; undiscovered historical equivalent calculations remain a priority risk.
title: Irrationality exponent and the complete logarithmic ordinal-entropy spectrum of rotations
